title: CAT 2021 Question Paper (Slot 1, PYQ) - Quantitative Ability - Interest
subject: Quantitative Ability

questions.q: Anil invests some money at a fixed rate of interest, compounded annually. If the interests accrued during the second and third year are ₹ 806.25 and ₹ 866.72, respectively, the interest accrued, in INR, during the fourth year is nearest to
questions.explain:
In compound interest, the interest accrued in consecutive years forms a geometric progression, with the common ratio equal to $(1 + R/100)$.
Interest for the 2nd year = ₹ 806.25.
Interest for the 3rd year = ₹ 866.72.
Common ratio = $866.72 / 806.25 = 1.075$. The interest rate is 7.5%.
The interest for the 4th year will be the interest of the 3rd year multiplied by the common ratio:
Interest for 4th year = $866.72 \times 1.075 = 931.724$.
Nearest option is ₹ 931.72.
